scope: Isolated textqa release WebView2, genuine keyboard/mouse editing, code menus and keyboard-operated tab ordering with two untitled drafts. No file picker, original file, user notes or system clipboard mutation.

checks.name: Real Alt+mouse adds two editable cursors and one undo restores both simultaneous insertions
A captured continuous selection alone is batch-replaced and one undo restores all replacements without changing outside text
Unicode line/column navigation counts emoji and Tab as one character each and inserts at the expected position
Encoding and EOL metadata undo/redo independently while preserving exact Unicode body and a recoverable untitled-only draft
Actual code menus indent/outdent, comment with undo, and fold/unfold JavaScript while preserving its complete body
Keyboard-operated real tab-order menu reorders two drafts; Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab preserve both exact bodies and per-document settings
